You must meet both the Basic Requirement and the Specialized Experience to qualify for this series as described below. BASIC REQUIREMENT: Applicants must have IT-related education and experience demonstrating each of the four competencies listed below at a proficiency level equivalent to the next lower grade level in federal service.

Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: A qualified candidate's online application and resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level GS-14 in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position is defined as meeting ALL of the following: Managing and disseminating information to stakeholders while serving as a senior IT official. Providing administrative and policy direction to the organizational elements reporting to the Office of the Chief Information Officer.

Managing computer facilities, equipment, and telecommunications network. "Experience" refers to paid and unpaid experience. Examples of qualifying unpaid experience may include: volunteer work done through National Service programs (such as Peace Corps and AmeriCorps); as well as work for other community-based philanthropic and social organizations.

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills; and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Limit your resume to no more than two (2) pages.

If more than two pages are submitted, only the first two pages will be reviewed to determine your eligibility and qualifications. Your full resume will be made available to the hiring manager if you are referred.

This position as a Natural Resource Manager, is an outstanding opportunity for a candidate with skills in Geospatial technologies, biological sciences, ecology, or other environmental sciences. Employee will serve as the Natural Resource Manager of the Ice Age National Scenic Trail (NST).

The position is in Cross Plains, Wisconsin, is supervised by the Trail Manager for the Ice Age NST, with an office building situated on NPS Property along the Ice Ace Age NST route. The NPS property is located within and makes up some acreage of the larger Cross Plains Ice Age National Scientific Reserve and State Park.

The Ice Age NST is a premier recreational footpath that generally follows the edge of the last glacial advance in Wisconsin. The Ice Age NST is administered and managed in partnership between the National Park Service (NPS), Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources (WDNR), and Ice Age Trail Alliance (IATA).

When completed, the Ice Age NST will meander for approximately 1,200 miles through Wisconsin, from Potawatomi State Park in Door County to Interstate State Park in Polk County. Today, approximately 700 miles of the Ice Age NST have been constructed and are open for use.

The Ice Age NST preserves outstanding landscapes and landscape features, resulting from continental glaciation. The National Park Service is responsible for overall administration, planning, compliance, interpretation, signage, and some land acquisition.

At the full performance level (GS-09) the major duties of this position include, but are not limited to the following: Carry out provisions of the National Trails System Act (P.L. 90-543, as amended) pertaining to the geospatial aspect of planning and administering of the Ice Age NST.

Administers all functions related to ArcGIS, technical support, and collecting data with GPS while proposing creative ways to use technology to advance development of the trail and advanced interpretation. Creates presentations of findings and effectively communicates project details to interested parties, partners, and members of the public.

Develop project workplans and implementation strategies leading to the accomplishment of restoration efforts, trail development, mitigation actions, and participate as a member of the planning and interdisciplinary team.

Interprets variables, trends, correlations, and interrelationships between data and conditions of work projects and provides reports to managers and interested parties.

Encourages and facilitates cooperation, pride, trust, and teamwork mentality that fosters the commitment to the Ice Age National Scenic Trail and supports the goals established with partners. Duties will be developmental in nature when filled below the full performance level.

In determining if your employment advances the public interest, the agency will consider: your performance and conduct; the needs and interests of the agency; whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service.

Under applicable law, the employment of an individual serving a probationary or trial period automatically terminates when that period ends unless the agency affirmatively certifies, in writing, that the individual's employment should continue and that their appointment should be finalized.

In the absence of agency action to affirmatively certify continued employment beyond the probationary or trial period, such appointments are terminated. Upon completion of your probationary period your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.

Specialized experience is experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to successfully perform the duties of this position.

Deine Rolle bei uns
Als Senior IT-Projektmanager (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Softwareentwicklungsprojekte – von der Übergabe aus dem Vertrieb über die Projektinitialisierung bis zum erfolgreichen Go-Live.
Du steuerst mehrere Projektteams sowie interne und externe Stakeholder, schaffst Transparenz über Qualität, Budget und Termine und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte nachhaltig erfolgreich umgesetzt werden. Dabei verbindest du technisches Verständnis mit unternehmerischem Denken und einer lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise.
Aufgaben
Du verantwortest die Planung, Steuerung und erfolgreiche Umsetzung komplexer Softwareentwicklungsprojekte hinsichtlich Qualität, Budget und Termintreue.
Du führst mehrere cross-funktionale Projektteams fachlich und koordinierst interne Mitarbeitende, Kunden sowie externe Partner.
Du gestaltest den Übergang vom Vertrieb in die Projektumsetzung und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Kunden ein tragfähiges Projektsetup. Dabei schärfst du Anforderungen, definierst den Scope und stellst einen strukturierten Projektstart sicher.
Du steuerst Projekte in Multi-Vendor-Umgebungen und koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit verschiedener Dienstleister.
Du identifizierst technische, organisatorische und wirtschaftliche Risiken frühzeitig, leitest geeignete Maßnahmen ab und sorgst für ein aktives Stakeholder-Management.
Du begleitest Projekte bis zum erfolgreichen Go-Live, stellst eine hohe Lieferqualität sicher und identifizierst gemeinsam mit dem Kunden Potenziale für eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit.
Du bereitest Steering Committees, Management-Reportings und Kundentermine professionell vor und moderierst diese souverän.
Qualifikation
Mehrjährige Erfahrung (mind. 3–5 Jahre) in der Leitung komplexer IT- oder Softwareentwicklungsprojekte.
Erfahrung in der Steuerung mehrerer Projektteams sowie unterschiedlicher Stakeholder in anspruchsvollen Projektumgebungen.
Fundierte Kenntnisse agiler Vorgehensmodelle wie Scrum, Kanban oder SAFe sowie Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit agilen Entwicklungsteams.
Erfahrung an der Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb und Delivery sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Projektkalkulation, Scope Management und wirtschaftliche Projektsteuerung.
Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Multi-Vendor-Projekten sowie in der Verantwortung für Budget, Qualität und Termine.
Technisches Verständnis moderner Softwareentwicklung (z. B. Softwarearchitekturen, Cloud, DevOps und CI/CD), um mit Architekt:innen und Entwicklungsteams auf Augenhöhe zusammenzuarbeiten. Eine eigene Entwicklerlaufbahn ist hierfür nicht erforderlich.
Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Werk- und Dienstverträgen sowie Verständnis für Qualitätssicherung, Teststrategien, Abnahmeprozesse und Go-Live-Szenarien.
Sicherer Umgang mit Jira, Azure DevOps oder vergleichbaren Projektmanagement-Tools.
Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Moderations- und Konfliktlösungskompetenz sowie ein souveränes Auftreten gegenüber Kunden und Management.
Strategisches Denken, unternehmerisches Handeln und eine strukturierte, pragmatische Arbeitsweise.
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2).

Zertifizierungen wie PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master oder SAFe.
Erfahrung im Software Engineering, in der Solution Architecture oder im DevOps-Umfeld.

Physical Requirements: This position includes a level of physicality normally associated with inpatient care, including bending, grasping, kneeling, performing moderation lifting, carrying tasks of up to 35 pounds per the Safe Patient Handling and Mobility (SPHM) guidelines and using appropriate mechanical lift.

Candidate must possess the ability to pivot their waist and neck, push and pull items not greater than 35 pounds and reach within a five-foot distance or above shoulder height. The position requires sitting , squatting, standing, walking and twisting , alongside wrist flexion and extension.

Employees are expected to employ proper body mechanics during lifting. Requires adequate vision to accurately perform the assigned duties, distinguish basic colors and assess patients and the environment safely. The position requires the ability to hear at a level to perform the assigned duties and the use of hearing aids permitted.

Examples may include but are not limited to: Significant amounts of time standing assisting assigned patients Utilization of safe patient handling and mobility protocols

Highstreet is seeking a Project Manager to support and lead delivery of operational and ERP/HCM projects for our public sector clients . This resource must have strong communication skills, love speaking with clients, engineering, partner organizations and our executive team.
The everyday workload includes Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) engagements, PeopleSoft and E-Business Suite (EBS) initiatives, and broader legacy ERP/HCM enhancement and modernization projects. In this role, you'll coordinate project activities, manage client communication, and ensure successful execution across planning, testing, and go-live (or cutover, for on-premises and infrastructure engagements).
You'll work closely with cross-functional teams, apply structured PMO processes, and help drive consistent, high-quality delivery across a mix of cloud, on-premises, and infrastructure environments.

Project Planning & Coordination

· Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables across ERP, HCM, and infrastructure (OCI) workstreams.

· Align scope and requirements with Oracle Cloud, PeopleSoft, EBS, and OCI capabilities in partnership with solution architects and technical leads.

· Maintain project documentation, logs, and repository structure (RAID, RTM, agendas, testing, etc.).

· Incorporate process flow validation and transaction lifecycle checkpoints into project plans, including legacy system dependencies.

· Support onboarding, project setup, and adherence to PMO templates and processes, including those specific to public sector engagements.
Client & Stakeholder Management

· Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for client communication, including public sector agency stakeholders.

· Manage expectations around timelines, deliverables, risks, and change requests.

· Lead recurring status meetings and ensure agendas and meeting minutes are posted.
Team Leadership & Collaboration

· Coordinate work across functional, technical, infrastructure, and QA team members.

· Support onshore/offshore alignment and help resolve blockers or conflicts.

· Review team progress, documentation, and performance against project expectations.
Budget & Tracking

· Monitor project budgets, burn rate, and staffing updates in partnership with project administrators.

· Support forecasting and financial reporting activities.

· Ensure testing scenarios reflect accurate transaction lifecycles and edge cases across both cloud and on-premises systems.
Risk, Issue & Change Management

· Log and track risks, issues, and action items.

· Facilitate mitigation discussions and escalate items when needed.

· Identify risks related to process breakdowns, incorrect accounting, or integration gaps across transaction flows, including legacy system constraints.

· Support the change control process and ensure proper documentation of out-of-scope work.
Testing, Cutover & Go-Live Support

· Coordinate SIT, UAT, and testing documentation across ERP, HCM, and infrastructure projects.

· Ensure test scenarios validate end-to-end transaction integrity, including accounting, approvals, integrations, and reporting outputs.

· Ensure test cases, logs, and approvals are completed and tracked.

· Support cutover planning, go-live execution, and post-go-live readiness for both cloud implementations and legacy system enhancements.
Governance & Reporting

· Provide regular project status updates using R/Y/G indicators and required client reports, including public sector-specific reporting requirements.

· Ensure compliance with Highstreet 's methodology and participate in internal QA/PMO checkpoints.

· Help improve post-go-live handoff processes and lessons learned documentation.

· Bachelor's degree in Accounting, IT, Business, or related field.

· 2–5 years of project management experience, ERP, HCM projects a plus, and infrastructure implementations (cloud or on-premises).

· Experience reviewing or supporting functional design documents (FDDs), process flows, or accounting mappings.

· Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

· Experience with project management tools (JIRA, MS Project, etc.).

· Ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage multiple workstreams across cloud and legacy environments.

· Highly detailed, multi-threaded, and high-energy, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

· Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), ERP systems, reporting systems, and web applications.

· Experience supporting public sector clients or government agency engagements.

· Ability to “connect the dots” between business operations, system configuration, and downstream reporting impacts.

· Familiarity with PMO governance, RAID management, and change control processes.

· PMP, CAPM, or Agile certification is a plus

Evaluates current program services in a systematic manner, including the collection, tabulation, and presentation of program statistics, trends, and outcome measures.

Leads regularly scheduled meetings (e.g., weekly) of the telemental health team to address issues and facilitate program planning.

The first Swatch watches surprised everyone with their revolutionary concept, creative design and provocative spirit. Today Swatch continues to innovate and surprise with new models, collections and special editions.

The brand maintains a strong presence in the world of sports with its commitment to snowboarding, freeskiing, surfing, beach volleyball and mountain bike slopestyle. Right from the start, Swatch connected with art and artists, and Swatch watches remain a prominent canvas for artists from a broad range of disciplines.
In order to reinforce the Quality team at its Headquarters in Bienne, Switzerland, SWATCH is currently searching for a

In addition, you are bilingual French and English, every additional language such as German is a plus

# Senior Projektleiter/-in Digitale Vorhaben 100% #
Willkommen in der faszinierenden Welt der Steuern! Das kantonale Steueramt erhebt gemeinsam mit den Gemeindesteuerämtern die Steuern für den Bund, den Kanton und die Gemeinden. Wir unterstützen Privatpersonen und Unternehmen im gesamten Steuererhebungsprozess. Dafür engagieren sich rund 800 qualifizierte Mitarbeitende am Standort in Zürich Altstetten.
Die kommenden Jahre sind im Steuerwesen des Kantons von mehreren bedeutenden Digitalisierungsprojekten geprägt. Für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung bauen wir unser Team in Digital Services weiter aus und suchen mehrere Senior IT-Projektleiter/-innen, die komplexe Projekte gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen, IT und Gemeinden vorantreiben.

* Du führst anspruchsvolle und komplexe Digital- und IT-Projekte mit hohem Technologieanteil - von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung - und stellst die Einhaltung von Terminen, Budget und Qualitätsstandards sicher.

### Dein Profil ###
* Du verfügst über mehrjährige, nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Projekte und Linienführung mit hoher Ergebnisverantwortung - idealerweise in Grossprojekten mit Millionenbudgets.

* Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und trittst überzeugend sowie souverän auf. Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen, triffst fundierte Entscheidungen und bringst unternehmerisches Denken sowie die nötige Ausdauer mit, um komplexe Vorhaben erfolgreich voranzubringen.

* Projekte mit hoher Sichtbarkeit und nachhaltigem Beitrag zur digitalen Transformation der Verwaltung.

Global Trials Optimization Specialist
Sponsor Dedicated/ Remote - US only
Are you energized by using data, planning, and cross-functional collaboration to help clinical trials enroll successfully? We’re seeking a Global Trials Optimization Specialist to support program feasibility, recruitment and retention planning, and in-life trial optimization across global clinical studies.
In this role, you’ll help translate trial goals, country input, modeling data, and enrollment insights into practical strategies that support study execution. You’ll partner with clinical trial teams, vendors, legal, analytics, and other stakeholders to identify enrollment opportunities, address challenges, and support patient- and site-facing recruitment efforts.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining clinical trial operations, feasibility strategy, recruitment planning, stakeholder coordination, and performance analysis to help studies reach the right participants.

Program Feasibility and Trial Optimization
Gather data, benchmarks, and modeling inputs to support feasibility and trial optimization planning.
Support program review development, including content review and escalation of requirements as needed.
Plan timelines for validation, deliverable development, stakeholder alignment, presentation preparation, and country validation requests.
Support validation and Clinical Trials Allocation Committee activities, including scenario planning, risk table inputs, validation review, modeling updates, and final allocation requests.
Author the initial Global Trials Optimization Report and maintain subsequent report updates throughout the trial lifecycle.
Complete recruitment needs assessments and ensure trial-level GTO reports remain current and actionable.
Recruitment and Retention Planning
Lead early recruitment and retention planning during feasibility, including inputs for project cost estimates.
Develop initial recruitment needs assessments and, where applicable, program-level recruitment budget estimates.
Submit vendor requests and prepare recruitment and retention plans.
Partner with legal on concept reviews, vendor proposal reviews, scope of work finalization, and material or tactic reviews.
Ensure recruitment and retention plans, including enrollment support materials, are implemented effectively.
Oversee enrollment support material development and tactic execution.
Provide required materials to the Metrics, Analytics & Performance team to support accurate Study Optimizer plan entry.
Request and manage appropriate system updates as trial needs evolve.
In-Life Trial Management
Partner with study teams to identify enrollment challenges, assess risks, and recommend potential mitigations.
Manage routine enrollment support materials and vendor activities.
Monitor enrollment performance and prepare standard reporting.
Analyze performance trends and identify opportunities for enhanced support.
Coordinate enhanced enrollment support activities, which may include:
Rescue site and country activities
Internal recruitment and retention refresher meetings
External recruitment and retention booster meetings
Additional participant- or site-facing materials
Rescue vendor engagement
Advocacy engagement and community outreach

Experience supporting clinical trials, feasibility, recruitment planning, enrollment strategy, or trial optimization.
Strong ability to gather, interpret, and apply data to support planning and decision-making.
Experience coordinating timelines, deliverables, stakeholder reviews, and cross-functional inputs.
Ability to work with clinical trial teams, vendors, legal, analytics, and other business partners.
Strong written communication skills, including the ability to develop clear reports, plans, updates, and study-facing materials.
Detail-oriented approach with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced clinical research environment.

Oncology clinical trial experience, especially in lung or breast cancer studies .
Prior experience as an oncology site coordinator .
Experience with recruitment and retention vendors, enrollment support materials, or patient/site-facing recruitment tactics.
Familiarity with enrollment monitoring, performance analysis, country validation, risk tables, or trial allocation processes.
Why This Role Matters
Successful clinical trials depend on reaching the right participants, supporting sites effectively, and responding quickly when enrollment challenges arise. As a Global Trials Optimization Specialist, your work will directly support smarter planning, stronger recruitment strategies, and more effective trial execution.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence global study planning, collaborate with experienced clinical research partners, and help improve how trials connect with patients and sites.
Candidate Profile
We’re especially interested in candidates with oncology trial experience and a strong understanding of site operations, enrollment strategy, and recruitment/retention planning. Internal candidates will be prioritized initially; external candidates may be considered after the initial internal review period.
If you’re a clinical research professional who enjoys bringing structure, insight, and strategy to trial enrollment planning, we’d like to hear from you. Apply today to help support meaningful clinical trials through thoughtful feasibility, recruitment, and optimization work.

We’re a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable—and we’re looking for passionate people to help us get there.
For more information, visit .
Why This Role Is Important to Arcadia
At Arcadia , the Enterprise Implementation Manager (EIM) is the customer's primary point of accountability from contract signature through the life of the relationship.

The EIM manages a portfolio of enterprise accounts, leading each customer through onboarding and the technical work required to bring them live — including project managing new data connector builds — but the role exists to protect and grow the value the customer realizes from Arcadia 's platform.

EIMs proactively build the client relationship, drive adoption, resolve risk before it threatens retention, and act as the customer's trusted advisor long after go-live, ensuring customer value is clearly tracked & regularly reviewed.
The ideal candidate is a relationship-first operator: someone who can run a technical delivery workstream competently, but who is just as comfortable owning a client conversation, coaching a teammate, or spotting an account risk before it becomes a retention problem.
What Success Looks Like
In 3 months
Complete onboarding and current product and enablement certifications; build a working understanding of the platform, data model, and Arcadia 's customer success playbooks. The optional Arcadia Certified Professional program is available for continued growth. Shadow tactical client touchpoints and status conversations to learn how EIMs build trust and manage expectations across a client relationship
Take ownership of a defined workstream — for example, project managing a new data connector build — with support from your manager and technical partners
In 6 months
Independently manage cross-team workflows (data integration, configuration, connector builds) while keeping priorities visible and surfacing risk early
Lead tactical client conversations and standing touchpoints, delivering clear, timely updates that keep stakeholders aligned and confident
Proactively identify and escalate delivery or account risk, applying established playbooks to resolve issues efficiently and maintain momentum
Begin building trusted relationships with client stakeholders, understanding their unique technical and business priorities
Contribute to Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), or steering committees for your accounts, and become fluent in maintaining account health scores in Planhat
Build fluency with Arcadia 's customer feedback channels, including the Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT), as part of engaging your accounts
In 12 months
Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts as the primary point of contact — coordinating delivery, connector project management, and ongoing value acceleration & account health under one roof
Drive accountability for on-time, high-quality delivery of commitments, from new data connector implementations to platform adoption milestones
Independently lead recurring QBRs, EBRs, or steering committees, and own the Planhat health score and NPS trajectory for your portfolio, working toward a consistently green status
Partner effectively with the Customer Growth and Retention (CGR) team on renewal and expansion conversations, providing account context and continuity while CGR owns the commercial process
Identify and document process or value improvements, contributing refinements that strengthen delivery consistency and customer outcomes
Share lessons learned and best practices with peers, informally mentoring newer EIMs and Project Associates
What You'll Be Doing
Customer Relationship & Trust
Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts, serving as the customer's primary point of contact throughout the engagement.
Lead tactical status conversations and standing project meetings, delivering clear, timely updates on progress, risk, and next steps.
Facilitate regular touchpoints to align priorities, answer client questions, and maintain stakeholder trust.
Prepare accurate, client-ready documentation and materials that support transparent communication.
Account Health & Governance
Serve as the customer's primary point of accountability for delivery outcomes and overall account health across your portfolio.
Lead recurring QBRs, EBRs, or steering committees with client leadership, tying progress to shared goals, ROI, and next steps.
Maintain each account's health score in Planhat, incorporating usage, engagement, and other signals; own the goal of moving accounts toward a consistently green status. Contribute to your segment's (Core, Enterprise, or National) Net Promoter Score (NPS), which factors into incentive compensation at the segment level rather than by individual account.
Build fluency with Arcadia 's customer feedback channels — including CSAT — as part of the company's growing Voice-of-Customer program.
Partner with the CGR team on renewal and expansion conversations, providing account context, continuity, and delivery insight; CGR owns the commercial renewal and upsell process.
Proactively identify and escalate delivery and account risk; apply established playbooks to resolve issues efficiently.
Maintain project and account momentum through consistent follow-through and clear ownership of open items.
Drive accountability for commitments by managing dependencies and communicating progress across all workstreams.
Implementation & Data Connector Project Management
Project-manage new data connector builds and platform configuration workstreams from kickoff through validation and go-live.
Ensure smooth data orchestration through configuration validation, and maintain detailed documentation of process flows and integrations.
Partner cross-functionally with Data & Health Platform (DHP) teams and engineering to resolve data alignment issues and strengthen reporting reliability.
Cross-Functional Coordination
Manage workflows to maintain alignment and efficiency across internal teams, third parties, and the client.
Coordinate delivery activities and track interdependencies so priorities stay visible and risks surface early.
Ensure project team collaboration and escalate promptly if a workstream is tracking behind.
Value Realization & Continuous Improvement
Identify and document process or workflow enhancements that improve customer outcomes and internal efficiency.
Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing refinements and strengthening knowledge capture across projects.
Connect delivery and account activities to the customer's broader adoption and value-realization goals.
Coaching & Knowledge Sharing
Share lessons learned and best practices from client engagements with peers and newer team members.
Apply feedback to continuously refine your own skills and performance, modeling a growth mindset for the team.

English Language Proficiency: Psychologists must be proficient in spoken and written English in accordance with VA Handbook 5005, Part II, Chapter 3, section A, paragraph 3j.

Education: Have a doctoral degree in psychology from a graduate program in psychology accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA), the Psychological Clinical Science Accreditation System (PCSAS), or the Canadian Psychological Association (CPA) at the time the program was completed.

The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed. For the purpose of meeting this requirement, the term "specialty area" refers to the specific specialty areas recognized by the accrediting body and not to specific job duties that might require special skills.

Currently, APA accredits doctoral programs in the specialty areas of clinical psychology, counseling psychology, school psychology, or combinations of two or more of those areas. PCSAS accredits doctoral programs in psychological clinical science.

CPA accredits doctoral programs in clinical psychology, counseling psychology, clinical neuropsychology, and school psychology. There are no job assignments in VHA that require the skills of a school psychologist; therefore, an applicant with a degree in the specialty area of school psychology is not eligible for appointment.

Strictly for the purpose of determining eligibility for appointment as a psychologist in VHA, there is no distinction between the specialty areas (with the exception of school psychology).

OR Have a doctoral degree in any area of psychology and, in addition, successfully complete a re-specialization program (including documentation of an approved internship completed as part of the re-specialization program) meeting both of the following conditions: The re-specialization program must be completed in an APA or a CPA accredited doctoral program; and The specialty in which the applicant is retrained must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

NOTE: The applicant must provide an official transcript and/or certificate documenting the completion of the re-specialization program, which includes completion of an APA or CPA internship. OR Have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution, with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature.

AND Internship: Have successfully completed a professional psychology internship training program that was accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed and that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR New VHA psychology internship programs that are in the process of applying for APA accreditation are acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement, provided that such programs were sanctioned by the VHA Central Office Program Director for Psychology and the VHA Office of Academic Affiliations at the time that the individual was an intern.

OR VHA facilities that offered full-time, one-year pre-doctoral internships prior to PL 96-151 (pre-1979) are considered to be acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement.

OR Applicants who completed an internship that was not accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed may be considered eligible for hire only if they are currently board certified by the American Board of Professional Psychology in a specialty area that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

(NOTE: Once board certified, the employee is required to maintain board certification.) OR Applicants who have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature may fulfill this internship requirement by having the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience in a site specifically acceptable to the candidate's doctoral program.

If the internship experience is not noted on the applicant's official transcript, the applicant must provide a statement from the doctoral program verifying that the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience was completed in a site acceptable to the doctoral program.

Licensure: Hold a full, current, and unrestricted license to practice psychology at the doctoral level in a State, Territory, or Commonwealth of the United States, or the District of Columbia.

Are you passionate about translating strategy into measurable business impact? Join Swiss Re-s Client Data Management team within Life & Health Reinsurance, where you will collaborate with senior leaders and cross-functional teams across all regions to shape and deliver the next phase of our global client data agenda.-

As-Senior Client Data Management Project Manager, you will have the overall responsibility for project delivery across the global Client Data Management agenda, from strategic framing through execution, change adoption and benefits realization.
Working closely with senior business sponsors, you will translate strategic direction and business priorities into executable plans, mobilize and engage cross-functional teams, manage dependencies and risks, and drive timely decisions.
This is hands-on delivery role where success means creating momentum, driving accountability and turning plans into outcomes. You will be equally comfortable setting the approach and driving the detail from facilitating senior-management discussions and governance forums to working directly with regional/functional teams to resolve issues and unblock delivery.
Current focus
Client data is increasingly important to decision-making and value creation across Life & Health Reinsurance providing a critical foundation for data-driven and AI-enabled capabilities. With strong foundations established, the focus is now on scaling our client data capabilities to meet growing demand for timely, trusted and reusable data.
In this role, you will be responsible for:-
* Project leadership:- Translate strategic priorities into clear project scope, milestones, delivery plans and measurable outcomes. Provide overall delivery oversight across interdependent workstreams and regions.
* Planning and prioritisation:-Establish structured approaches to prioritisation and delivery planning including resource and capacity requirements.
* Cross-functional delivery:-Mobilize and coordinate business and technology delivery across the Life & Health value chain, actively managing dependencies, risks and issues to drive agreed outcomes.
* Stakeholder management and governance:- Partner closely with project sponsors, functional leaders and senior stakeholders to maintain alignment and enable timely decisions. Provide concise, decision-ready reporting on progress, risks, trade-offs and areas requiring management intervention.
* Transformation and change:-Drive the evolution of client data processes, governance, accountabilities and ways of working, translating future-state direction into practical change and implementation plans.
* Resource and financial management: Work with functional and regional leaders to identify capacity and capability requirements, support resource and funding requests, and manage project financials.

The Client Data Management team within Life & Health Reinsurance is a global team responsible for ensuring client data is acquired, validated, ingested and made available across the business. Our mission is to deliver trusted and timely client data that enables confident decisions and sustainable value for Life & Health.

You combine strategic thinking with pragmatic execution, bringing structure and clarity to ambiguity while constructively challenging assumptions and influencing stakeholders across a global organization to drive outcomes.
You adapt your communication and leadership style across different audiences - from delivery teams to senior executives.

* 7+ years of experience leading projects and change initiatives, preferably within (Re)insurance.-
* Strong end-to-end project management experience across business and technology, including planning, governance, risk and dependency management, resource planning and financial management.
* Proven ability to translate strategic direction into execution, including shaping the approach where the path forward is not fully defined.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, working across functions, regions and seniority levels in a complex global organization.
* Experience delivering data and business transformation, including organizational and operating model design and implementation.

* Experience in Life & Health (Re)insurance.
* Experience with client data or data-driven business initiatives.
* Project and change management certifications (e.g. PMP, PROSCI, Scrum)-
For Switzerland, the base salary range for this position is between CHF 126'000 and CHF 188'000 for a full-time role. The specific salary offered considers:
* the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
* the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.
Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

Swiss Re is one of the world-s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. About This Job
The Senior Project Manager, GTM Launch owns the launch management system that gets Dutchie’s feature and product launches from ready-to-launch through adoption and measurable impact across our full product suite. This is a senior, autonomous role within Revenue Operations, acting as the connective tissue across Product, Engineering, Enablement, Marketing, Support, go-to-market teams, and most importantly, our customers.
You will lead complex launches with minimal oversight, proactively surface risk before it becomes an escalation, and own change management for both internal teams and customers. You’ll be equally comfortable driving a cross-functional operating cadence, influencing senior stakeholders when scope or timing is at risk, and pulling adoption data yourself to measure success and impact.
Success is not simply shipping on time; it is ensuring teams are ready, customers understand the value, adoption follows, and each launch makes the next one better.

Own end-to-end project management for assigned feature and product launches — scoping, sequencing, timelines, dependencies, go/no-go criteria, and post-launch follow-through — in partnership with Product and Engineering leads.
Maintain the launch board as the single source of truth, ensuring active launches have clear status, ownership, dependencies, risks, decisions, and next steps.
Establish and run efficient, action-oriented launch cadences that keep cross-functional teams aligned, surface decisions early, and drive clear accountability.
Design and run internal change management for each launch, including readiness plans for Sales, CSM, Support, Implementation, Marketing, and Enablement, with clear ownership of what must be true before GA.
Design and run customer-facing change management, including rollout sequencing, customer communications, pilot or cohort strategy, and coordination with Marketing and Support.
Proactively identify blocked or at-risk work, clarify tradeoffs, and coordinate solutions before stakeholders have to escalate.
Translate changes in scope, timing, or dependencies into clear downstream business and customer impact, and drive the right stakeholders toward decisions.
Develop working product knowledge deep enough to answer audience, functionality, and semi-technical questions on each launch without unnecessary escalation, connecting feature-level detail to customer and business impact.
Partner closely with Technical Writing and Enablement, validating that release notes, training materials, internal guidance, and customer communications accurately reflect product functionality and positioning.
Define success metrics before launch across internal readiness and external outcomes such as adoption, activation, usage, customer sentiment, and support volume.
Monitor post-launch performance and proactively engage pilot, alpha, or early-adopter customers to identify friction, validate value, and surface emerging risks.
Build feedback loops that turn launch data and customer signals into action — flagging underperformance quickly and driving retrospectives that result in clear owners and follow-through.
Continuously improve the launch operating system by identifying high-leverage process, tooling, or automation opportunities and driving stakeholder alignment through implementation.
Use AI and the broader tool suite to accelerate research, synthesize launch signals, improve documentation and reporting, identify risk patterns, and reduce manual work — while applying judgment and validating outputs.

5+ years of project or program management experience, with meaningful ownership of feature or product launches in a SaaS or technology GTM environment.
Demonstrated ownership of change management for both internal teams and external customers, including readiness, communications, rollout strategy, and adoption.
Strong analytical orientation: able to define launch success metrics, pull and interpret product or usage data, and translate findings into action.
Proven track record of proactive communication and risk management — surfaces issues early, frames tradeoffs clearly, and drives toward resolution.
Strong facilitation and operating-rhythm skills: keeps cross-functional groups focused, drives decisions, and creates clear accountability without relying on formal authority.
Demonstrated curiosity and follow-through: builds enough product and domain expertise to represent launches credibly with stakeholders and customers, and validates rather than assumes.
Experience improving cross-functional processes, systems, or tooling and driving those changes through adoption.

Sie überwacht die einheimische Vogelwelt, erforscht ihre Lebensweise und setzt sich für die bedrohte Vogelwelt ein. Sie kümmert sich um verletzte und verwaiste Vögel und informiert und berät die Bevölkerung und betreibt in Sempach ein Besuchszentrum. Die Vogelwarte beschäftigt über 200 Mitarbeitende in allen Landesteilen.
Wir teilen unseren Lebensraum mit Vögeln. Dies kann zu Konflikten und Problemen zwischen Vögeln und Menschen führen. Das Ressort Konflikte Vögel – Mensch erarbeitet Grundlagen zu verschiedenen Konfliktthemen und stellt Lösungsvorschläge sowie Information zur Verfügung. Es berät Ämter und Fachstellen und beantwortet Anfragen aus der Bevölkerung.
